operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case table names: Episode, Person, Award, Character_Award, Credit, Keyword, Vote; DDL quotes "Episode" but not others; identifiers must be double-quoted in generated SQL.
Episode.episode_id is TEXT PK with format 'S<season>-E<episode>' (e.g. 'S20-E1','S20-E10'); lexicographic order differs from numeric (E10 < E2).
Episode.air_date is TEXT storing ISO dates 'YYYY-MM-DD' but declared TEXT -> dispatches to String fuzzer, not Date; TS will not produce date-shaped values.
Person.birthdate is TEXT storing 'YYYY-MM-DD' with 64% NULL; also String fuzzer.
Award.season and Award.song are 100% NULL, distinct=0 -> empty literal pool; String sampler with no elements sets p=1 (always fresh random strings).
Award.person and Award.episode_id are FK columns with NULLs (14.7%, 42.7%); FK fill draws from parent values with replacement, no NULL injection upstream.
Character_Award has no PK and no NOT NULL; award_id FK to Award(award_id) but only 3 distinct values over 12 rows (many-to-one).
Credit, Vote, Keyword have no single-column PK; Keyword has composite PK (episode_id, keyword) -> composite-PK member max_l0=30.
Episode.season has distinct=1 (all 20) -> Number sampler list range collapses; TS will still draw full-range ints.
Episode.rating REAL distinct=9 in [6.5,7.2]; Number scale=4 default gives range [-10^4,10^4] -> implausible ratings.
Person.height_meters REAL 86% NULL, values ~1.7-2.0; Number fuzzer range [-10^4,10^4] -> implausible heights.
Credit.credited TEXT stores 'true'/'false' strings (not BOOLEAN); declared TEXT -> String fuzzer, no bool semantics.
operator_ts_expectations: String fuzzer on episode_id/title/summary/air_date/episode_image/name/birthdate/...: random charset a-zA-Z 0-9() with contamination; will not reproduce 'S20-E1' or ISO dates.
Number fuzzer on season/episode/number_in_series/votes/stars/year/award_id: full range [-10^4,10^4] (int) or [-10^4,10^4] float; implausible years (e.g. -5000) and votes.
Number fuzzer on rating/percent/height_meters: float range [-10^4,10^4] -> ratings like -3000.5, heights like 8000.0; drives FN on range predicates.
FK fill: Award.person drawn from Person.name final values; Award.episode_id from Episode.episode_id; Credit.person/episode_id likewise; Keyword.episode_id from Episode.
Character_Award.award_id drawn from Award.award_id (75 values) -> many-to-one preserved; but no PK so duplicates allowed.
Keyword composite PK (episode_id, keyword): sample_fresh_primary_keys drops duplicate (episode_id,keyword) pairs; keyword String fuzzer random.
Award.season/song empty pool -> String sampler p=1 -> always fresh random strings, never NULL; original is 100% NULL -> FN on IS NULL queries.
Person.birthdate 64% NULL but String sampler never emits NULL (drop None, p=1 if empty) -> FN on IS NULL / NULL-comparison queries.
Episode.season distinct=1: Number list range [20, 10^4] after quirk; TS draws full range -> season values like 5000.
No NOT NULL constraints anywhere -> TS never enforces; rows with NULL PK (episode_id, name, award_id) will fail insert and be skipped (writedb).
String contamination (prefix/suffix/drop char) on episode_id breaks FK joins to Episode if parent also contaminated differently -> FP on join-count queries.
Number perturbation (+-1,+-2) on award_id/year may create near-duplicate values; ties/duplicates in original (rating 9 distinct over 21 rows) not reproduced -> FP on DISTINCT/COUNT DISTINCT.
